quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 monthly revenue (company release, unaudited): consolidated net sales revenue of NT$ 45,091 million, a 0.9% increase month-over-month and a 576.62% increase year-over-year (August 2026: NT$44,690,268 thousand; September 2025: NT$6,664,140 thousand). Year-to-date consolidated sales revenue was NT$ 265,285 million, a 626.95% increase year-over-year.
